open_items: Header corrected to the real, language-matched class cover (EN page LEFTGRADIENT/EN-PAGE, AR page RIGHTGRADIENT/AR-PAGE; a neutral cover serves both). Language-matched class cover (LEFTGRADIENT/EN-PAGE on EN, RIGHTGRADIENT/AR-PAGE on AR; a neutral cover serves both). Verified servable server-side on CloudFront 2026-06-18. CloudFront is the design proof, NOT an approved email host: stage to the Ortto CDN (or prove with an inbox send-test) and swap before any send.

The 'our other classes' ClassCardGrid is now PORTRAIT instructor cards: three OTHER classes (cedric-haddad-teaches-personal-styling, elda-choucair-teaches-marketing, ragheb-alama-teaches-music-and-performance), each a text-free on-brand portrait with the instructor name and the Teaches subject phrase as a live HTML overlay, language-matched, linking to its class page. Portraits are the maharat.com grid images, verified servable on CloudFront; stage to Ortto before send.

Hero is the rights-cleared class key art (the page og:image), wired via the campaign hero_image. Deliverability is PENDING: a direct fetch of the CloudFront object returns 403 (likely WAF blocking datacenter IPs), so email-asset-qa blocks final pass until it is staged to the Ortto CDN or proven with a real inbox send-test. Neither raw CloudFront objects nor Drive catalog links are guaranteed hot-linkable in email.

Brand fonts (Lyon Arabic Display, 29LT Azer for AR; Acumin Pro for EN) are delivered via the Ortto-hosted custom-fonts CSS links in the head. 29LT Azer upload to Ortto is an open item (design system); until then the Arabic body falls back to Tahoma, Arial. No font binary is embedded or committed.
CTA destination points to the published class page. Confirm masterclass page vs signup gate vs plan picker at the human gate.

Send platform OPEN. Ortto not yet adopted (region, scoped API key, Arabic render test). The unsubscribe href is the {{ unsubscribe }} merge tag and view-in-browser the {{ view_in_browser_url }} merge tag, both wired at send.

Gate stack before any send: email-html-build eval, arabic-copy-qa or english-copy-qa per copy slot by data-lang, email-asset-qa on every image module, accessibility-qa (email render), compliance-privacy-check, brand-qa-reviewer, then the human gate. Copy is QA-passed; these slotted renders are not yet through the gate agents.
Gendered address in the Arabic copy is mixed (E1, E3, E4 read masculine, E2 feminine). Rendered faithfully from the approved copy. Flag for the copywriter if a single register is intended.
No price or plan stated, per the brief. The plan picker on the page carries the confirmed numbers.
